main_text.p: vocant, jubentque in novissimam horam omnia expedire, & ex Sapientis monito, agere pro viribus, quia nullum in sepulchro, quò innus [?], opus, nulla cogitatio. Hac propter uti festinamus, sic facile contemnit omnia, qui se semper cogitat esse mo-riturum. Quæ Hieronymi verba ita mea facio, ut Tibi ætatis provectæ viro, & mortem in proximo præstolanti non importuna credam vel ingrata. Deum veneror, ut & vitam nobis, & excessum largiatur, sibi honorificum, & salutarem nobis, atque Ecclesiæ.

p.i: Lugduni Batavorum, d. xvi. Maji, MDCLXII.

page.notes: Doubtful reading: "innus" at the line end of the first paragraph, possibly "minus" with a damaged m; the scan shows a dot after it. The date "cIↄ Iↄ c LXII" is converted to MDCLXII. Show-through from the reverse page (faint text in the middle and lower part of the page, including "vo-" at lower left) is omitted. The signature mark "** 2" is copied as printed.
